1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.
18: 
19: ## Mobile browser games
20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
23: - Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
24: - Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

(()=>{
const canvas=document.getElementById('game'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'),stage=document.getElementById('stage');
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id); const rand=(a,b)=>a+Math.random()*(b-a),clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
const relics=[
 {name:'Gravebound Signet',slot:'Ring',icon:'◉',rarity:'magic',stats:{might:3,luck:3},desc:'+3 Might · +3% Fortune'},

 {name:'Moonshard Blade',slot:'Weapon',icon:'⚔',rarity:'magic',stats:{damage:5,speed:5},desc:'+5 Damage · +5% Swiftness'},
 {name:'Ashen Mantle',slot:'Chest',icon:'♧',rarity:'legendary',stats:{armor:4,regen:.5},desc:'+4 Armor · +0.5 Recovery'},
 {name:'Foxfire Loop',slot:'Ring',icon:'◉',rarity:'magic',stats:{luck:8,speed:5},desc:'+8% Fortune · +5% Swiftness'}
];
const blessings=[
 {icon:'✦',name:'Edge of Ruin',desc:'Increase weapon damage by 25%.',apply:s=>s.damage*=1.25},
 {icon:'♥',name:'Blood of the Old Kings',desc:'Restore all vitality and gain 30 maximum health.',apply:s=>{s.maxHp+=30;s.hp=Math.min(s.maxHp,s.hp+30)}},
 {icon:'➶',name:'Fleet of Foot',desc:'Move 15% faster and strike 8% faster.',apply:s=>{s.speed*=1.15;s.cooldown*=.92}},
 {icon:'◈',name:'Iron Benediction',desc:'Gain 2 armor and reduce incoming damage.',apply:s=>s.armor+=2},
 {icon:'☼',name:'Soul Siphon',desc:'Collect soul motes from farther away. +20% reach.',apply:s=>s.magnet*=1.2},
 {icon:'⌖',name:'Keen Sight',desc:'Improve your fortune. Relics fall more often.',apply:s=>s.luck+=12},
 {icon:'✣',name:'Grave Tithe',desc:'Recover 0.4 vitality each second.',apply:s=>s.regen+=.4},
 {icon:'⚡',name:'Quickening',desc:'Increase attack speed by 18%.',apply:s=>s.cooldown*=.82}
];
const state={w:800,h:600,dpr:1,t:0,last:0,run:true,paused:false,dead:false,level:1,xp:0,xpNeed:8,kills:0,player:{x:400,y:300,hp:100,maxHp:100,might:10,armor:0,speed:150,damage:12,cooldown:.72,regen:0,luck:5,magnet:75,attack:0,dash:0,dashCd:0,healCd:0,dir:0},keys:{},enemies:[],orbs:[],drops:[],particles:[],floaters:[],gear:{Weapon:null,Chest:null,Ring:null,Boots:null},recent:[],spawn:0,shake:0,elapsed:0,aim:null};
let audioOn=false,audioCtx=null,lastToast=0;
function resize(){const r=stage.getBoundingClientRect(),d=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);state.w=r.width;state.h=r.height;state.dpr=d;canvas.width=Math.floor(r.width*d);canvas.height=Math.floor(r.height*d);canvas.style.width=r.width+'px';canvas.style.height=r.height+'px';ctx.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);state.player.x=clamp(state.player.x,24,state.w-24);state.player.y=clamp(state.player.y,24,state.h-24)}
new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(stage);resize();
const worldPattern=(()=>{let a=[];for(let i=0;i<75;i++)a.push({x:rand(0,1200),y:rand(0,900),r:rand(8,28),type:Math.random()});return a})();
function totalStats(){let s={...state.player};for(const item of Object.values(state.gear))if(item)for(const[k,v]of Object.entries(item.stats)){if(k==='hp'){s.maxHp+=v;s.hp=Math.min(s.hp,s.maxHp)}else if(k==='speed')s.speed+=v*1.5;else if(k==='damage')s.damage+=v;else if(k==='might')s.might+=v;else if(k==='armor')s.armor+=v;else if(k==='luck')s.luck+=v;else if(k==='regen')s.regen+=v}return s}
function showToast(text){const el=$('toast');el.textContent=text;el.classList.add('show');lastToast=2.2}

function particle(x,y,color,n=8,power=75){for(let i=0;i<n;i++){let a=rand(0,Math.PI*2),v=rand(power*.25,power);state.particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*v,vy:Math.sin(a)*v,r:rand(1,3),life:rand(.25,.65),max:.65,color})}}
function floater(x,y,text,color='#e8ca85'){state.floaters.push({x,y,text,color,life:.9})}
function spawnEnemy(){let p=state.player,edge=Math.floor(rand(0,4)),x,y;if(edge===0){x=rand(0,state.w);y=-24}else if(edge===1){x=state.w+24;y=rand(0,state.h)}else if(edge===2){x=rand(0,state.w);y=state.h+24}else{x=-24;y=rand(0,state.h)}let t=state.elapsed,kind=Math.random()<Math.min(.36,t/150)?'brute':Math.random()<.28?'wisp':'ghoul';let scale=1+Math.floor(t/65)*.12;let base=kind==='brute'?36:kind==='wisp'?13:20;state.enemies.push({x,y,type:kind,hp:base*scale,maxHp:base*scale,speed:(kind==='wisp'?80:kind==='brute'?38:53)+Math.min(t*.12,24),damage:kind==='brute'?13:kind==='wisp'?6:8,r:kind==='brute'?17:kind==='wisp'?10:13,attack:0,phase:rand(0,7),flash:0})}
function dropGear(x,y){let s=totalStats(),chance=.09+s.luck*.003;if(Math.random()>chance)return;let item={...relics[Math.floor(Math.random()*relics.length)]};state.drops.push({x,y,item,life:18,bob:rand(0,6),r:12});particle(x,y,item.rarity==='legendary'?'#ff9b4e':item.rarity==='rare'?'#ffe16e':'#8fc5ff',13,45)}
function spawnOrb(x,y,value=1){state.orbs.push({x,y,value,r:4+value*.4,phase:rand(0,6),life:45})}
function killEnemy(e){state.kills++;spawnOrb(e.x,e.y,e.type==='brute'?3:1);dropGear(e.x,e.y);particle(e.x,e.y,e.type==='wisp'?'#9bc8da':'#a34d4c',12,95);floater(e.x,e.y-16,'+'+(e.type==='brute'?3:1),'#d9c47e');sound(120,.07,'triangle');e.dead=true}
function nearestEnemy(){let p=state.player,best=null,bd=Infinity;for(let e of state.enemies){let d=Math.hypot(e.x-p.x,e.y-p.y);if(d<bd){bd=d;best=e}}return best}
function startDash(){let p=state.player;if(p.dashCd>0||state.dead||state.paused)return;let dx=(state.keys.d||state.keys.ArrowRight?1:0)-(state.keys.a||state.keys.ArrowLeft?1:0),dy=(state.keys.s||state.keys.ArrowDown?1:0)-(state.keys.w||state.keys.ArrowUp?1:0);if(!dx&&!dy){dx=Math.cos(p.dir);dy=Math.sin(p.dir)}let m=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;p.dash=.22;p.dashCd=3.2;p.dashX=dx/m;p.dashY=dy/m;particle(p.x,p.y,'#a5c9d1',10,35);sound(260,.16,'sawtooth)}
function heal(){let p=state.player;if(p.healCd>0||state.dead||state.paused)return;if(p.hp>=p.maxHp){showToast('Your vitality is already whole.');return}p.hp=Math.min(p.maxHp,p.hp+35);p.healCd=12;particle(p.x,p.y,'#c75e55',18,55);floater(p.x,p.y-25,'+35 VITALITY','#e98b75');sound(520,.25)}

  localstorage-clear          clear all localstorage
  sessionstorage-list         list all sessionstorage key-value pairs
  sessionstorage-get <key>    get a sessionstorage item by key
  sessionstorage-set <key> <value> set a sessionstorage item
  sessionstorage-delete <key> delete a sessionstorage item
  sessionstorage-clear        clear all sessionstorage

Network:
  requests                    list all network requests since loading the page. each request is numbered for use with the `request` command.
  request <index>             show full details (headers, body, response) of a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  request-headers <index>     print only the request headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  request-body <index>        print only the request body for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  response-headers <index>    print only the response headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  response-body <index>       print the response body for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command. textual bodies are inlined; binary bodies are saved to a file and the path is printed.
  route <pattern>             mock network requests matching a url pattern
  route-list                  list all active network routes

DevTools:
  console [min-level]         list console messages
  run-code [code]             run playwright code snippet

  video-chapter <title>       add a chapter marker to the video recording

  video-hide-actions          stop annotating actions performed on the page
  show                        show playwright dashboard
  pause-at <location>         run the test up to a specific location and pause there
  resume                      resume the test execution
  step-over                   step over the next call in the test
  generate-locator <target>   generate a playwright locator for the given element
  highlight [target]          show (or with --hide, remove) a highlight overlay for an element; `--hide` without a target hides all page highlights.

Install:

Browser sessions:

  kill-all                    forcefully kill all browser sessions (for stale/zombie processes)

Global options:

## Objective
- Build a complete playable game themed “2D Diablo loot in a Vampire Survivors run.”

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG (viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game with canvas-rendered survival combat, auto-attacking, Diablo-style relic loot and equipment, level-up blessings, dash, healing, pause, and restart.
- Chose a dark, gothic “Gloamfall” setting; controls are WASD/arrows, Space, and Q.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the playable game in `index.html`.
- Confirmed the inline JavaScript parses successfully.
- Captured and inspected the latest screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/game.jpg`.

### Active
- No active work reported.

### Blocked
- Browser automation via `playwright-cli` could not start because its expected Chromium installation was missing (`Browser "chromium" is not installed`); a screenshot was instead captured using system Chromium in headless mode.

## Next Move
1. Optionally perform a browser interaction check of movement, level-up selection, pause, and restart.
2. Summarize the implementation and verification caveat to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; the first browser automation attempt failed, but system Chromium successfully captured a screenshot.

content.text:
Built a complete, playable browser game in `index.html`: survive waves of enemies, auto-attack, collect soul motes to level up, choose blessings, and equip dropped relics. It also includes movement, dash, healing, pause, restart, sound effects, and a responsive layout.

Verified the inline JavaScript parses and `git diff --check` passes. I captured and inspected a screenshot; browser interaction testing was unavailable because `playwright-cli`’s Chromium installation was missing, so I used system Chromium for the visual check.

Assumption: the game is a self-contained, no-build browser experience.
